google_review_notes: No login required. Tap Play on the main menu to start level 1; the first tile to tap is marked with an X and is always safe. Long-press (or switch on Flag mode in the bottom bar) to flag a mine; tap a number whose mines are flagged to open its neighbours. Daily puzzle, Level Select, Shop and Settings are all on the main menu. Logic puzzle with AdMob ads and optional in-app purchases; no account, chat or user-generated content.
apple_review_notes: No login required. To test IAPs, open Shop from the Minesweeper main menu; Restore Purchases is in Settings. Start level 1 by tapping the tile marked X (always safe). No demo account needed.
